turns.message: I'm at an estate sale and there's a Ludwig Acrolite snare drum for $150. I sell on eBay. What's my true profit if it resells for $215, and should I buy it?
turns.reply: PASS. Most I would pay is $58.82. At $150 you would make $26.46 if it resells at $215.

turns.message: I'm shipping cross-country, so put shipping at $35 instead. Does the answer change?
turns.reply: PASS. Most I would pay is $49.82. At $150 you would lose $0.54 if it resells at $215.

turns.message: What did I tell you I was looking at? And remind me of the asking price I mentioned.
turns.reply: You told me you were at an estate sale and were looking at a Ludwig Acrolite snare drum, with an asking price of $150.
